seo.title: Launchy Image Converter | Convert Images to WebP or SVG
seo.description: Convert JPG, PNG, HEIC and more to fast WebP images or SVG vectors right in your browser. Add SEO alt text and file names, then copy ready-made HTML.

imageAlt: Launchy Image Converter, a tool to convert images to WebP or SVG

converter.dropText: Select, drop or paste your files. Each PDF page or slide becomes an image. Nothing leaves your device.

webp.label: WebP
webp.hint: Recommended for websites. Small files with great quality.

svg.label: SVG
svg.hint: Traces the image into vector shapes. Best for logos and icons; photos make large files.

converter.transparentHint: Removes a solid background color. Best for logos and icons.
converter.enclosedHint: Turn off to keep that color where it is surrounded by the design.
converter.batchHint: Each image gets a number: hotel-logo-01, hotel-logo-02. A name typed on an image replaces it.
converter.pdfError: {name} could not be read. The file may be damaged.
converter.pdfLocked: {name} is password protected. Remove the password and try again.

item.backgroundKept: No solid background found, so it was kept.
item.altHint: Helps Google and screen readers. Aim for under {max} characters.
item.copiedAnnounce: HTML for {name} copied to the clipboard
item.errorDecode: This file could not be read. Try a JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC image.
item.errorConvert: The conversion failed. Try again or use another image.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

footer.note: Images are converted in your browser and never uploaded.
